headline.zh: 合并仍无协议与条款；感恩节后 TSLA 大涨 5.22% 收于 400 美元、SPCX 涨 4.83%，市场押注合并；马斯克称特定情景下 SpaceX 市值「会高得多」
headline.en: Still no merger agreement or terms; after Thanksgiving TSLA jumps 5.22% to $400 and SPCX gains 4.83% as markets price in a deal; Musk says SpaceX's market cap 'would be way higher' in one long-term scenario

summary.zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月 28 日（亚洲/新加坡），Tesla 与 SpaceX（SPCX）仍未宣布合并协议、换股比例或监管文件，两家公司也没有新的官方声明。过去 24 小时没有新的合并进程报道，最新信息仍是 FT 11 月 24 日（未经公司确认）关于谈判委员会、顾问和年底目标的报道。市场方面，11 月 27 日（周五半日市）TSLA 收 400.00 美元（+5.22%），24/7 Wall St. 将其归因于合并预期；SPCX 收 133.59 美元（+4.83%），CNBC 归因于科技股反弹和马斯克扩大赠股计划。马斯克在 X 上回复一位用户对 SpaceX 2042 年的设想，称「在那种情景下，SpaceX 市值会高得多」，其余主要谈 Grok Bot 和 FSD，没有谈合并。
summary.en: As of 28 November 2026 (Asia/Singapore), Tesla and SpaceX (SPCX) still have no announced merger agreement, exchange ratio or regulatory filing, and no new official statements. There was no new reporting on the merger process in the past 24 hours; the latest remains the FT's 24 November report (not confirmed by the companies) on the negotiating committees, advisers and year-end target. In markets, on Friday 27 November (a half session) TSLA closed at $400.00 (+5.22%), which 24/7 Wall St. tied to merger speculation, and SPCX closed at $133.59 (+4.83%), which CNBC tied to a tech rebound and Musk's expanded share gift. On X, Musk replied to a user's 2042 scenario for SpaceX that 'in that scenario, SpaceX market cap would be way higher'; otherwise he mostly posted about Grok Bot and FSD, and did not discuss the merger.

points.zh: 合并进程：过去 24 小时无新的确认或新报道。仍以 FT 11/24 报道为准（全股票、约 3.5 万亿美元、目标年底、「尚未接近达成」，未经公司确认）。
points.en: Merger process: nothing new confirmed or newly reported in the past 24 hours. The FT's 24 November report remains the reference (all-stock, about $3.5 trillion, year-end target, 'not close'; not confirmed by the companies).

points.zh: 行情：TSLA 11/27 收 400.00 美元（+5.22%，区间 384.66–401.18，成交约 2,663 万股，低于均量）；SPCX 收 133.59 美元（+4.83%），接近 135 美元 IPO 价。上涨是市场定价，不是交易进展。
points.en: Markets: TSLA closed at $400.00 on 27 November (+5.22%, range $384.66–$401.18, about 26.6 million shares, below average); SPCX closed at $133.59 (+4.83%), near its $135 IPO price. The move is market pricing, not deal progress.

points.zh: 溢价与换股比例（分析师观点）：汇丰情景为按 30 日均价溢价 33%（每股 507 美元），Gary Black 估 25%（481 美元）并警告全股票报价可能把 SpaceX 压到 100 美元以下；RBC 称 TSLA 持有人可能接受无溢价合并。条款均未公布。
points.en: Premium and exchange ratio (analyst views): HSBC's scenario is a 33% premium to the 30-day average ($507 a share); Gary Black sees 25% ($481) and warns an all-stock bid could push SpaceX below $100; RBC says TSLA holders might accept no premium. No terms have been published.

points.zh: 马斯克 X：回复用户对 SpaceX 2042 年（Starlink、百万颗 Starmind 卫星、登月登火）的设想，称「那种情景下 SpaceX 市值会高得多」；另发「Tesla super vision」谈 FSD v15。未谈合并。
points.en: Musk on X: replied to a user's 2042 scenario for SpaceX (Starlink, a million Starmind satellites, Moon and Mars) that 'SpaceX market cap would be way higher'; also posted 'Tesla super vision' about FSD v15. No merger comments.

points.zh: 日程：FT 报道的目标是年底前签约（1 月 3 日新国会就职前）；RBC 认为公告或在 2027 年初；欧盟 TCMV 辅助驾驶会议 12/15。
points.en: Calendar: the FT reported a target to sign by year-end (before the new Congress sits on 3 January); RBC sees an announcement by early 2027; EU TCMV Assisted Driving meeting on 15 December.

tsla_analysis.zh:
TSLA 11 月 27 日（周五半日市）收 400.00 美元，较 11/25 的 380.14 美元上涨 19.86 美元（+5.22%），区间 384.66–401.18 美元，成交约 2,663 万股，低于均量；盘后约 398.85 美元。24/7 Wall St. 称涨势由合并预期带动，并指出 TSLA 过去 12 个月市盈率约 439 倍、上季营业利润同比下降约 56%，上涨能否延续取决于换股比例。SPCX 同日收 133.59 美元（+4.83%）。本期未见新的卖方评级变化。

OptionCharts 显示 11 月 27 日 TSLA 期权成交 182 万张，与 20 日均量持平，成交认沽/认购比 0.69；30 日隐含波动率降至 49.75%（前次 54.38%），IV Rank 48.72%，IV 百分位 98.81%，历史波动率 65.12%；一年 IV 区间 36.84%（10/29）至 63.35%（11/20）。股价上涨伴随 IV 回落，卖出看跌期权的权利金比上周略低，但合并条款、年底时间窗和欧盟审批的不确定性仍在。以上为公开数据摘录，不是价格或波动率预测。
tsla_analysis.en:
TSLA closed at $400.00 in Friday 27 November's half session, up $19.86 (+5.22%) from $380.14 on 25 November, with a range of $384.66–$401.18 on about 26.6 million shares, below average; after hours it was about $398.85. 24/7 Wall St. said the rally was driven by merger speculation, noting a trailing P/E of about 439x and a roughly 56% year-on-year fall in last quarter's operating income, so whether the gain holds depends on the exchange ratio. SPCX closed at $133.59 (+4.83%) the same day. No new sell-side rating changes were seen.

OptionCharts shows 1.82 million TSLA option contracts traded on 27 November, in line with the 20-day average, with a volume put/call ratio of 0.69; 30-day implied volatility fell to 49.75% (prior 54.38%), IV Rank 48.72%, IV percentile 98.81% and historical volatility 65.12%; the one-year IV range is 36.84% (29 October) to 63.35% (20 November). The rally came with lower IV, so put premiums are a little thinner than last week, but uncertainty over merger terms, the year-end window and EU approval remains. This is a summary of public data, not a forecast of price or volatility.
